verdict: Maybe. Yaan Man from Ahmedabad pitched makeup for men on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Men's grooming is growing, but makeup is still new for most Indian men, so education and subtle products are needed.
angle: Concealers, tinted moisturisers and brow products for men are growing among young urban buyers. Subtle, natural-look products and how-to content help first-time users.
